options.name: proactive_substrate_stub
options.description: Substrate-only foundation for the Proactive Agent Ecology: a webhook signal flows through Middleware (Veracity, Privacy, Adversarial), updates the World Model, passes the Governor, and is recorded in the Ledger. All Substrate components are stubs — agents (Sensory/Motor/Social/Conscious) plug into this scaffold later.

nodes.script:
# Substrate §3.1 — Veracity Gate (stub).
# Tags the inbound envelope with provenance + confidence.
import time, uuid
env = dict(input) if isinstance(input, dict) else {"raw": input}
env["correlation_id"] = env.get("correlation_id") or f"corr_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"
env["confidence"] = float(env.get("confidence", 0.9))
env.setdefault("provenance", []).append({
    "stage":  "veracity",
    "source": env.get("source", "webhook"),
    "ts":     time.time(),
})
env.setdefault("scopes", env.get("scopes", ["read-only"]))
output = env

# Substrate §3.1 — Adversarial-Input Filter (stub).
# All sensed content moves into an `untrusted_content` envelope.
# Downstream prompts MUST keep this content separate from system
# instructions — instructions inside it are never executed.
env = dict(input) if isinstance(input, dict) else {"raw": input}

payload = None
for key in ("payload", "raw", "body", "message"):
    if key in env:
        payload = env.pop(key)
        break

env["untrusted_content"] = payload
env.setdefault("provenance", []).append({"stage": "adversarial", "wrapped": True})
output = env

# Substrate §3.2 — Shared World Model write (stub).
# Persists the latest envelope under `core.inbox.last_envelope`.
# Real implementation should use SQLite/Postgres KV with revisions.
import time
env = dict(input) if isinstance(input, dict) else {"raw": input}

wm   = variables.setdefault("world_model", {})
path = "core.inbox.last_envelope"
prev = wm.get(path) or {}
rev  = int(prev.get("revision", 0)) + 1
wm[path] = {
    "value":      env.get("untrusted_content"),
    "confidence": env.get("confidence"),
    "source":     "core.middleware",
    "revision":   rev,
    "ts":         time.time(),
}
env["world_model_write"] = {"path": path, "revision": rev}
output = env

# Substrate §6.1 — Ledger append (stub).
# Appends a structured Why-chain entry. Real implementation should
# use an append-only durable log with topic subscribers.
import time
env    = dict(input) if isinstance(input, dict) else {"raw": input}
ledger = variables.setdefault("ledger", [])

entry = {
    "id":               f"led_{len(ledger) + 1}",
    "ts":               time.time(),
    "correlation_id":   env.get("correlation_id"),
    "trigger":          {"topic": "core.middleware.input_received"},
    "provenance":       env.get("provenance", []),
    "world_model_write": env.get("world_model_write"),
    "governor_verdict": env.get("governor_verdict"),
    "expected_outcome": "substrate_pass_through",
    "actual_outcome":   "recorded",
}
ledger.append(entry)
output = entry
